scenarios.context: A boy tells his friend about falling off his bike.

speakerA.en: What happened to your knee, Arman?
That sounds dangerous. Were you wearing a helmet?
Did anyone help you?
You should be more careful, but I'm glad you're safe.

speakerB.en: I fell off my bike on the way to school. A car stopped suddenly in front of me.
Yes, luckily. Otherwise I could have hurt my head.
A kind woman called my parents and cleaned the cut. I was lucky she was there.
I will. From now on I'll cycle only on quiet roads.

scenarios.context: Two students talk about a car accident near school.

speakerA.en: Did you see the accident near the school this morning?
Was anybody hurt?
What did you do?
That was the right thing to do. Many people just stand and watch.

speakerB.en: Yes, two cars hit each other at the crossing. It was scary.
One driver had a small injury, but an ambulance arrived quickly.
I stayed away, called the emergency number and told them where it was.
My teacher says we should always stay calm and call for help.

scenarios.context: A girl tells her friend about an unexpected meeting.

speakerA.en: I missed my bus this morning, so I walked to school and met an old friend.
Miss Parker, my old English teacher. She told me about a free speaking course.
Next month. It's an amazing opportunity, and there are only twenty places.
I will. Sometimes a bad start to the day brings a good surprise.

speakerB.en: Really? Who was it?
That's interesting. Does it start soon?
You should register today before the places are full.
True. Maybe missing the bus was your lucky break.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk about an exchange trip.

speakerA.en: Our school is choosing students for an exchange trip. Are you going to apply?
It's a great opportunity. You'd meet students from another country.
You'll miss home, but you'll also gain experience and make new friends.
Do that tonight. The deadline is on Friday.

speakerB.en: I'd like to, but I'm afraid. I've never travelled without my family.
I know, but what if I feel homesick?
That's true. Perhaps I should talk to my parents first.
Okay. I'll fill in the form tomorrow if they agree.

scenarios.context: A student loses his bag and learns a lesson.

speakerA.en: You look worried. What happened?
Oh no! Did you call the bus company?
You were lucky. What did you learn from this experience?
That's a good lesson. Everyone makes mistakes.

speakerB.en: I left my bag on the bus with my phone inside.
Yes, and they found it. I'm going to pick it up this afternoon.
I learned to check my things before I get off, and to put my name on my bag.
Yes. Next time I'll be more careful and keep my phone in a front pocket.
